reviews.text: Good location, price, and trustworthy people

I wanted to thank Claudia for her wonderful service and for explaining everything about the Covis dog daycare. She was incredibly friendly and helpful, patiently explaining all the fees, how the daycare works, and answering all my questions. It's so nice to meet people who treat you with such care and inspire confidence from the very first moment. Thank you so much! ❤️

I was looking for a place to leave my dog ​​on Orense Street and I stumbled across this place by chance. I wasn't sure if he'd adapt to the space, but Claudia, who mainly takes care of my dog ​​Berlin, made it very easy for him to adjust and treats him with such affection that he appreciates it, as if he were family. I would definitely recommend it.

Since I met Tinchi, a year and a half old Westie, at their grooming salon, I haven't taken him anywhere else for his haircut and wash. They are excellent professionals. Very caring. He loves going and has a great time playing with the other dogs. They are a pleasure to be around. I recommend them 100%.

Excellent place. My puppy is super happy and they treat him very well. Everyone is so nice and we couldn't be happier. Before he started going to the doggy daycare, he had trouble interacting with other dogs and people, but now I see him getting happier and more social every day.
Fantastic!!! I'm so happy with my furry friend Zeus's haircut. They're true professionals, and I've found my go-to groomer. Highly recommended!

COVIS has given our giant dog a wonderful welcome and has been a big part of her settling into a new home and environment. At COVIS, she enjoys both staying at the doggy daycare and going for walks with the other dogs. Our pet has learned to manage an urban environment much better thanks to the patience, professionalism, and positive energy of the daycare and its experts. She's always happy to arrive there and comes home exhausted from playing with the other dogs. Thank you!

I want to recommend Covis because my dog ​​had some behavioral issues with other dogs, and since he started going to daycare, I've noticed a huge change. He's much calmer and more sociable.

Also, it's been a great help to be able to go to work knowing he's not alone at home and is in good hands. You can tell they treat him with so much love and attention.

I definitely recommend taking your dogs to Covis. 🐶❤️
Amazing and trusted at all levels. People are great and service is one of the best I have found in Madrid.

I took Pipo for the first time and I was thrilled. They made him look gorgeous, he smelled amazing, and you can tell they treat the dogs with so much love and patience. They also gave me several very useful tips on coat care and maintenance, which I really appreciated as a puppy. You can tell when someone truly loves what they do. We'll definitely be back 😊

I've taken my dog ​​Penny twice and she's always been fantastic. Besides doing a great job, the whole team is incredibly friendly and attentive. You can tell they treat the dogs with a lot of love. We'll definitely be back! 😊 …
I left my dog ​​for a few hours to do some sightseeing and it was great. Good value for money.

My dog ​​Anchoa has had a pass since January to go to the kennel one or two days a week, because even though we work from home, we thought it would be good for her to socialize.

We're happy because it not only helps her socialize, but it also prevents separation anxiety, gets her used to being without us, teaches her basic behavior (like not eating the houseplants), and she comes back exhausted 😅 which is fantastic on days when we have dinner plans or something and she has to stay home alone.
My puppy is happy going to Covis. He plays and has a great time, and the staff are lovely!
We've been a couple of times for the hairdressing service and they couldn't make Bica look any more beautiful. The girls are lovely. We'll be back!

Our dog has gone blind, and this new condition has made him distrustful and extremely nervous. He feels so comfortable here that we wouldn't consider leaving him anywhere else. He comes in happily, just like he's in his own home. The grooming service is also excellent. Thank you so much!

We bathed my dog ​​Simba and he looked amazing. He's a white Shiba Inu who's a bit afraid of water, but he didn't complain at all. They gave him the peace he needed, and the result was perfect. He's white, soft, and smells great. Plus, he's been shedding less since we bathed him. A really good experience that we'll definitely repeat.

We had a grooming appointment with our 9-month-old English Cocker Spaniel puppy. We'd only had one previous experience at a dog groomer, and it was a bad one. They could barely work with him; they said he was too nervous.

Today they sent us videos of the process where he looked relaxed, happy, and cooperative.

The work was patient, incredibly thorough, and we received excellent feedback. We'll definitely be back.

Everyone we interacted with was so kind and caring. Thank you so much!

This is the first time I've left Enzo at a doggy daycare, and I couldn't be happier. Since he's still a puppy, I felt a bit sad, but the care they provide is excellent, which puts my mind at ease. Enzo is happy, learning to socialize and play with other dogs in a safe and loving environment. It's definitely been a very positive experience, and I can't recommend it enough.
Taking Mowgli to the groomer was a great decision! He's a timid dog, but when we picked him up he was so happy and content with the girls! We'll be back!!

I feel so lucky to have found this place to leave my dog ​​while I go to work.
Leaving Kira with Claudia and Cecilia gives me complete peace of mind knowing she's in the best hands. A huge thank you to COVID Hernani. ❤️❤️❤️ I highly recommend it.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Hi! I'm very happy with the service. I took my dog ​​for a haircut, nail trim, and general cleaning. He came out smelling great and, most importantly, he was calm, happy, and playing with other dogs when I went back to pick him up.

The atmosphere is excellent, and the staff is very friendly and professional. You can tell they care for and give the dogs positive energy. I will definitely consider them for dog daycare as well. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
We left our 4-month-old puppy Bilma at Covis and it's become our go-to dog daycare! They're so attentive to the dogs and the service is fantastic! Thank you so much, team!

Canela is thrilled to be staying at Covis! It's so reassuring to know she's well cared for and pampered while I work. They maintain super-fast contact and communication at all times, and keep us updated on how Canela is doing.
I've been taking my dog ​​there for a few weeks now and I'm delighted. The service I've received from the very beginning has been excellent. My dog ​​is happy every day!

My dog ​​Mia, who regularly goes to Covis's doggy daycare, had her "hairdresser's" day today. The result was spectacular: I haven't seen her looking so beautiful in ages. Her fur looks incredible... and she smells amazing. The white on her paws is pure white! 😳 And the black on her back was gleaming like never before. Silvia, the groomer, has a special touch, because Mia, who doesn't usually like baths, was happy and cooperated completely. A detail that shows Silvia's care and professionalism is that she didn't want Mia to go outside until her fur was completely dry. Thank you so much, Silvia and Covis! ❤️🐶

The grooming service was excellent...my dog ​​niece came out even more beautiful thanks to the girls in Hernani...
Thank you so much 😊🫂 …

My fur baby was at the groomer and he looks gorgeous!!!!

We're thrilled!!!
We'll be back.
I loved the service, both for my dog ​​and me! They are so kind 🫶🏻! With impeccable grooming service 👌🏼! We loved it 👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻 we will definitely be back 🫶🏻… …
A wonderful place where I leave my dog ​​to be looked after when I can't be. And she goes in happier than when she gets home... A dog doesn't lie; if she likes it, you can tell.

My experience at this dog daycare has been wonderful. From day one, the care, professionalism, and attention the team gives to each dog and owner is evident. They take the time to learn about each dog's routines, personality, and needs, which inspires a great deal of confidence. My dog ​​comes home happy, relaxed, and perfectly cared for. It's lovely to see how much the staff enjoys their work and creates a safe and loving environment. Without a doubt, this is a highly recommended place for anyone looking for a second home for their furry friend.
They absolutely wonderfully care for your pets!!! Without a doubt, the best pet daycare in Madrid.
A 10 out of 10!!!
Best team in the world! Monchu is happy!

I took Chapo to this doggy daycare on a friend's recommendation, and it was a great decision. The place is spacious, clean, and has a great atmosphere, but the best thing is undoubtedly the Covi team: attentive, patient, and incredibly loving towards the dogs. They told me how he had settled in, sent me photos throughout the day, and even gave me some tips for his routine. Chapo came back happy, relaxed, and eager to return. You can tell when they're cared for with love. I highly recommend them!
Thank you so much, Silvia!
The hair salon is fantastic! Very good!
Thank you so much, Carmen!

The best doggy daycare in the world! Moka goes happily every day to play with her doggy friends and receive tons of love from the best staff!
The moment she leaves home, she runs straight to COVIS.

I recommend it to everyone because of the wonderful people who work there. They couldn't care less for the dogs or be more attentive to every detail.

Thank you so much for everything ❤️❤️
They were very attentive and loving with my dog! I highly recommend them!

Great place!
Very friendly and professional too.

We are delighted with the nursery. Oliva goes there happily every day, and you can tell how much her teachers love her. 🥰 It's a place full of love and joy, and seeing her enjoy herself so much makes us very happy. We wholeheartedly recommend it! …

Very happy with the service. It's not overcrowded with dogs, they get natural light, and they treat them very well.
Highly recommended.
Excellent doggy daycare service, with daily updates on my dog. They also offer a high-quality dog ​​trainer service.

It's an excellent place to leave your pet! Azula always comes back very happy!! The staff always sends us photos and keeps us updated on what happened during the day. Everyone is very friendly. I highly recommend it. 🫶 …
My dog ​​received excellent service at the grooming salon. They made her look gorgeous.
I'm delighted to have found this daycare where the treatment, kindness, and care for my dog ​​is exceptional. I highly recommend Covis to everyone.
Thanks Melane!! :)

Fantastic dog daycare! The staff is lovely, they take such good care of the dogs, and you can tell they love what they do. They send videos and also post updates on their Instagram stories, so even if you're far away, you can check on them.
I go to work with complete peace of mind because my dog ​​Manolito always comes back happy and exhausted from playing—he even pulls to get back!
Highly recommended!

It's spectacular! My little Bob is thrilled, and I'm even more so. It's a great place, they treat the animals with so much love, and they send me photos and videos throughout the day. I'm absolutely delighted and highly recommend it! ❤️❤️
